one_liner: Nifty 50 gains 0.63% amid strong FII inflows and broad-based rally.
flows_line: FIIs were net buyers with Rs 7,284.03 Cr, DIIs sold Rs 3,712.23 Cr.
watch_next: Watch for BOE Monetary Policy Report at 21:30 IST tomorrow.
lesson_seeds: FII inflows can drive market gains.
Sectoral surges can lead broader rallies.
Global market trends influence local sentiment.
Decreased volatility often accompanies market rallies.
